sayLines.line: Erin is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
Giulia came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
Navjot came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
🧭 Selasie is back from the east. "It's... different out there. I'll tell you about it." (Ask them what they saw.)

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

Deeper knowledge: Mayapple. Uses: the ripe fruit is delicious. Unripe fruit, leaves, roots = poison. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: ONLY the fully ripe fallen fruit — everything else is toxic; medicine: root resin is potent medicine — expert use only, small doses.
🪤 David is back from the snares: +348 kcal to the pantry.
★ IDENTIFIED: Neem. Feathery leaves, bitter smell. Medicine, not food — small amounts only. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Navjot stops mid-fight and binds the wound — field medicine, +20 HP.
📓 Codex: Angelo taught David Herbal Medicine.
Field medicine on Priya: clean the wound, poultice it, bind it right — the sickness has nowhere left to stand. Priya is going to make it. (Navjot cured them — and the camp saw it.)
📓 Codex: David taught Navjot Herbal Medicine.

📓 Codex: Navjot taught Selasie Herbal Medicine.
⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
